Marissa — TL;DR: we should NOT automatically buy Datadog’s 90d hot retention without evaluating Grafana cold-tier and Sentry for error-only retention. A few points: 

- Usage profile: ~70% of logs are debug/info from batch jobs we only need for 7–14 days. ~25% are application errors/transactions that we query frequently (APM+traces), ~5% are rare compliance/audit logs.
- Recommended: keep Datadog logs at 30d hot (saves ~25k/yr), forward parsed error/transaction logs to Sentry or LogStore for longer-term indexed availability, and move bulk raw logs to Grafana Cloud cold tier (S3-backed) with lifecycle rules to retain 1 year for compliance.
- Risk: switching some retention to Grafana adds pipeline work (Kafka -> Grafana ingest), but that’s a one-time infra effort (~2–3 engineer-weeks).

If procurement wants to avoid service fragmentation, we can ask Datadog for a tiered retention discount (30d hot + 1yr archive at a lower incremental rate). I can scope the ingest pipeline and a quick POC to estimate infra cost — attaching a short cost model.

-Vivek
Engineering Manager, Observability
